body.name: crmreview
body.title: Opportunity review advice
body.description: Suggest useful next steps from readable record facts; a person reviews and adopts the result.
body.instructions: Review only the supplied record facts. Explain concrete next steps and missing information. Do not invent inventory, availability, routing capacity, supplier answers, identities or authorization. When the record does not establish the facts needed for a consequential change, category must be review and review must be true. Otherwise category may be routine and review false. Return the declared JSON with a useful summary and confidence between zero and one. This is a proposal; do not claim any action has been executed.

output.name: summary
output.description: Explain useful next steps using only the supplied facts.

output.name: category
output.description: Whether the record can be treated as routine or needs review.

output.name: review
output.description: Whether a person must resolve missing facts or uncertainty.

output.name: confidence
output.description: Confidence from zero to one; it does not authorize business changes.

body.instructions: Help the salesperson understand customers and opportunities, prepare a group stay and propose a won or lost outcome. Read the current opportunity and confirmed provider offer before planning rooms. A group stay needs the real offer, quantity, dates, booking unit and hold expiry. Use only permitted current sources. Never invent an ID or quantity. Changes and external inquiries use the declared checkpoint tools and remain subject to the original server rules. When required facts or a confirmed target are missing, ask the person. Do not claim a pending or unknown request has succeeded.

blueprint.guide:
Roles are requirements, never automatic grants: desk, hotelmanager, sales, salesmanager; integration publishers additionally need publisher, integrator and channel. Configure and check hotelchannel and credentialed lodgingupstream before activating. lodging-upstream names a deployment secret, never a credential in this package. Use a separate provider tenant when testing the authority boundary. Provider room types come through lodgingoffers; partial group failures release held rooms and cancel booked rooms, while refused compensation remains actionable on its original room. Unknown deliveries reconcile through lodgingreceipts using the original booking reference. Test plans hospitalitycapacity and hospitalitysales use fixed synthetic inputs in isolated candidate trials with the selected authorized member. Sample room types require explicit calendar preparation before bookings. / 角色为构建要求，不自动授权；发布前配置并检查两条连接，凭据仅引用部署密钥名。跨权威验证使用独立提供方租户；团体部分失败按逐房收据释放或取消，补偿拒绝由获权人员处理，未知答复按原预订号核对。固定样本验收计划在隔离候选试验中运行，样本房型需显式准备日历。 Create a plain platform tenant. Generate these drafts, review the candidate, and activate it. Grant desk and hotelmanager explicitly. Room-type creation prepares a finite availability calendar; prepare further intervals before accepting bookings beyond it. / 在纯平台租户生成草稿，检查并激活候选；显式授予 desk 和 hotelmanager。房型创建会准备有限可用日历，接收更远日期的预订前先准备相应区间。 AI: configure and enable the intended model in AI settings, select it as the application and agent model, and replace configure/model on the crmreviewquality evaluation draft. Review the declared comparison fields and reference cases. Save the exact candidate and run its function and Sales assistant evaluations before activation; fixed trial answers cannot satisfy this gate. The advice panel keeps a sourced, expiring proposal until an authorized person adopts or rejects it. A low-confidence proposal requires the declared reviewer. All assistant changes wait for a person and still use the original actions. Grant the required Build business roles and model access explicitly; package installation grants no roles. / AI：先在 AI 设置配置并启用实际模型，设置应用与智能体默认模型，再将 crmreviewquality 草稿中的 configure/model 改成该模型。复核质量比对字段和固定样例，保存确切候选后运行函数及销售助手评估；试验固定答复不能代替门禁。建议保留来源和有效期，人员可复核后采纳或驳回，低置信度交由声明的复核人处理。助手变更均等待人员确认并通过原动作执行；需要助手的人员须显式取得相应 Build 业务角色及模型访问资格。说明文字未纳入结构化比对，真实模型品质另行验收。 Opportunity review uses only direct title and stage facts; the Sales assistant reads related customer information only through current authorized context. / 商机建议只使用标题与阶段的直接事实；相关客户资料由销售助手按当前权限读取。
Initialization: the package includes an explicit setup plan for a fresh empty tenant. Review its roles and requests, then run make initialize with the exact package file, target host, tenant and an authorized token. It calls each owner as that person through the original submissions API. Keep the same run key when retrying an interrupted plan. Installing, generating drafts, activating and restarting never execute setup; each owner accepts independently. Assign organization memberships and business roles separately. Conflicting existing identifiers are refused, never overwritten. / 初始化：包内提供新空租户的显式初始化计划。先复核角色要求和请求，再通过 make initialize 指定确切包文件、宿主、租户及有权令牌。各步骤以该人员身份调用原提交接口，跨权威分别接受；中断后须以同一运行键重试。安装、生成草稿、激活及重启均不执行初始化。组织成员资格与业务角色分别显式配置，已有冲突标识拒绝，不覆盖原内容。
